stress_suite.nature: actual native-thread stress: 4 producer OS threads racing bounded try_send against the single owner; exactly-once command disposition, complete write drain, exactly-once terminal delivery across a racing shutdown
stress_suite.separation_from_modeled_schedules: every repeat leg ran `cargo test [---release] -p ws-driver --test concurrency` — only the native-thread stress test binary. The modeled bounded-schedule exploration (rust/ws-driver/tests/schedule_exploration.rs) was NOT part of any repeat leg; it runs separately inside `make -C rust gates`. The suites share no test binary.
stress_suite.timing_model_note: the stress tests bound progress by iteration counts (POLL_BUDGET = 2,000,000 owner polls), not wall-clock deadlines, so emulation slowness and host load cannot convert slowness into spurious failure

both_blocking_platforms.definition_source: US-018 AC2 ("...on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64"), the plan context US-017 AC4 inherits; the US-018 closure receipt's three-vehicle pattern is followed exactly, including its emulation disclosure

flake_reconciliation.policy: any non-deterministic failure is investigated and either root-caused as a real bug (fixed RED-first with a minimized repro) or evidenced as environmental with the reconciliation written down; zero unexplained flakes permitted in the final record
flake_reconciliation.reconciliation: no failure of any kind occurred in 150/150 runs across all six legs, so there is nothing to reconcile. The runner is constructed so flakes cannot be silently dropped: it never aborts at the first failure (all N runs always execute) and records every run's real exit code and full output; a masked or swallowed flake is therefore structurally impossible in this record.

race_tooling.named_runtime_claim_NOT_made: No claim is made that the native-thread runtime has been verified free of data races by race-detection tooling. Per AC4's own rule, missing race tooling BLOCKS that named runtime claim, and this receipt does not make it. What IS claimed: (a) the native-thread stress suite passed 150/150 with repeat counts on darwin arm64 native, Linux aarch64 native-arch, and Linux x86_64 emulated (disclosed); (b) the language-level argument that #![forbid(unsafe_code)] on all crate roots plus zero non-path dependencies means safe stable Rust's type system statically excludes data races in this code — stated as a static language guarantee argument, explicitly NOT as the empirical race-tooling-verified runtime claim AC4 names.
